name: estat-pandas
what_it_holds: A pandas-datareader extension for Japan's e-Stat API — pulls series directly into pandas DataFrames. 0 stars, MIT, updated May 2026.

name: pykosis
what_it_holds: Python client to read Korea's national statistics (population, prices, employment, housing) from KOSIS OpenAPI; sibling to the author's R package `kosis` (5 stars). 0 stars but updated 10 Sep 2026 alongside the R version.
why_useful: Python-native alternative to korea-stats-mcp for direct KOSIS series pulls (housing/prices relevant to gap #13 crossover analysis too as a bonus).

name: kosis-openapi-mcp
what_it_holds: KOSIS OpenAPI CLI + MCP server with automatic period-splitting when a query would exceed the API's 40,000-cell limit. 0 stars, MIT, updated 13 Sep 2026 (very fresh).
why_useful: Handles KOSIS's cell-limit pagination automatically, useful if pulling long historical Korean series (multi-decade monthly data would otherwise need manual chunking).
